snippet.title: Galosphere (Minecraft Mod Showcase) | New Cave Biomes, Structure & New Boss  | Forge/Fabric 1.20.1
snippet.description:
🔔| Still not part of our community? Join our discord here: https://discord.gg/Fc38uu6FnZ

📌| You can watch the full video in Spanish by following this link:
https://youtu.be/YPvHwHaD-Ns

Galosphere is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds new features focused on underground content, from new cave biomes to a structure with its own boss. There are many things you can do with this mod and so many elements to play with, you will never get bored of it.

You can download the mod in this page:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/galosphere

or in Modrinth: 
https://modrinth.com/mod/galosphere

📌| Timestamps:

— Intro 0:00
— World Generation Features 0:28
— Lichen Caves 3:08
— Crystal Canyons 4:58
— Pink Salt Caves 8:24
— Pink Salt Shrine: Berserker Boss 10:53
— Outro 14:00

📺 Shaders used in this video:
Complementary Reimagined | EminGTR

Download this shader by following this link: 
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/complementary-reimagined

🎵 Music used in this video:
Green Path | Hollow Knight
Fungal Wastes | Hollow Knight
Crystal Peak | Hollow Knight
White Palace | Hollow Knight
Hornet | Hollow Knight
City of Tears | Hollow Knight
